goalbuddy_receipt_v1.rationale: Every oracle clause now has direct or shared-path proof. Selection reads one active task and rejects zero/multiple; exact fields map into TaskInput; preview returns an opaque runRequest consumed by the automatic run endpoint; GoalBuddy linkage survives createRun and the same finalizeSettledTask used by executeTask persists run.json and a separate schema-valid receipt. Source bytes remain hash-identical, changed source fails closed, checkpoint commits are disabled/rejected, and existing lock/status/diff/allowedPaths/checkpoint paths remain in force. All focused, regression, typecheck, build, diff, and board gates pass.
evidence: state.yaml -> preview: previewGoalBuddyTask reads only, requires exactly one status=active task, requires active_task id agreement, and hashes source bytes.
Exact mapping: objective -> title/prompt; allowed_files -> allowedPaths; verify -> verificationCommands; stop_if -> executionGuards; task id -> externalTaskId is asserted by the focused test.

No manual copying: /api/goalbuddy/preview returns runRequest and /api/goalbuddy/runs accepts the same selection, rebuilds/validates the preview, then uses createRun, project lock, persist, and execute.
Linkage: the focused test asserts goal slug, external task id, repository path, Orchestrator run/task ids, and goalReceiptPath in persisted run.json and the receipt envelope.
Run -> receipt: executeTask calls the exported finalizeSettledTask seam; the focused test calls that exact seam and validates both persisted run.json and the separate receipt JSON.
Receipt contract: GoalReceiptEnvelopeV1 JSON Schema is runtime-validated; success, failure, and interrupted outcome semantics are tested.
Board immutability: the focused test compares SHA-256 before/after; preview only reads, and finalization fails the task if the source hash changes or becomes unreadable.
No next-task selection: preview filters only the existing active card and rejects ambiguity; queued fixture T043 is never selected.
No automatic commit: preview forces checkpointCommits=false, validateQueue rejects true for linked tasks, and the execution prompt forbids commits; existing optional checkpoint code remains gated.
Existing safeguards: /api/goalbuddy/runs reuses acquireProjectLock, executeTask Git status/diff capture, outsideAllowedPaths enforcement, reviewer, checkpoint gate, and atomic persistence.
TDD evidence: initial red was previewGoalBuddyTask missing; follow-up red was finalizeSettledTask missing; both focused tests then passed.
Fresh verification: focused GoalBuddy test pass; npm test 35/35 pass; npm run check pass; npm run build pass; git diff --check pass; GoalBuddy board checker pass.
